integrity: Universal homotopy conclusion follows from explicit graph structure and CW cofibration gluing; finite executable instances are separately reproducible. Previous full-ladder and odd open-ladder theorems are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one deleted antipodal rung in each even-width Möbius ladder, n>=4; non-equivariant perfect-matching complex. No odd-width, arbitrary edge deletion or universal collapsibility assertion. Finite verification does not replace the infinite proof.
title: Deleting one antipodal rung contracts the perfect-matching complex of every even-width Möbius ladder
